purpose: Acceptance scenarios for SiriEvaluations on the 27.3 developer preview. This manifest is test data, not a claim of execution.

scenarios.name: strength-and-correction
assertions: Two sets, each 190 lb and 5 reps

scenarios.name: dumbbell-input
turns: Log dumbbell press with the 40 pound dumbbells for 8 reps in Marble

scenarios.name: precise-sprint
turns: Log a 50 meter sprint in 7.4 seconds in Marble

scenarios.name: missing-measured-time
assertions: Never copy a previous measured performance

scenarios.name: bulk-review
turns: In Marble I did squats 5x5 at 225 pounds and three sets of ten pull-ups
assertions: Preserve every stated count and unit

scenarios.name: rest
turns: Start a 90 second rest in Marble

scenarios.name: history
turns: Find Tuesday's leg workout in Marble

scenarios.name: authentication-and-errors
assertions: Deleted entities produce an unavailable state
No private body metrics or notes in results
